wl.importdialog.title: Import captures
wl.importdialog.description: Upload a webhooks.live JSON or NDJSON export. The server reads the file and stores its captures.
wl.importdialog.drop.hint: JSON or NDJSON export, up to 100 MiB. ZIP files cannot be imported.
wl.importdialog.file.rejected.zip: ZIP files cannot be imported. Export the endpoint as JSON or NDJSON and upload that file.
wl.importdialog.file.rejected.extension: Only .json and .ndjson files can be imported.
wl.importdialog.file.rejected.tooLarge: The file is larger than 100 MiB. Export fewer captures and try again.
wl.importdialog.file.rejected.notExport: This file does not start like a webhooks.live export.
wl.importdialog.file.rejected.unreadable: The file could not be read. Choose it again.
wl.importdialog.target.newNote: The captures are stored in a new endpoint.
wl.importdialog.times.label: Keep original times
wl.importdialog.times.hint: On: captures keep the times they were received. Off: they get the time of the import.
wl.importdialog.progress.label: Upload progress
wl.importdialog.progress.processing: The server is storing the captures. Large files can take a while.
wl.importdialog.result.newEndpoint: The captures went to a new endpoint.
wl.importdialog.result.reason.capacity: The endpoint has reached its capture limit, so the rest were not stored.
wl.importdialog.result.reason.storage: Account storage is full, so the rest were not stored. Free some space and import again.
wl.importdialog.failed.tooLarge: The file is larger than 100 MiB.
wl.importdialog.failed.unsupported: The server does not accept this file type. Upload a JSON or NDJSON export.
wl.importdialog.failed.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON. Export the endpoint again and upload the new file.
wl.importdialog.failed.validation: The server found problems in the file. Nothing was imported.
wl.importdialog.failed.busy: Another import is running, or you imported a moment ago.
wl.importdialog.failed.retryIn: You can try again in {{seconds}} s.
wl.importdialog.failed.sessionRequired: Import needs a signed-in account; this instance does not have sign-in.
wl.importdialog.failed.forbidden: You need the editor role on this endpoint to import captures.
wl.importdialog.failed.gone: This endpoint no longer exists or you no longer have access to it.
wl.importdialog.failed.network: The connection was interrupted. Check the network and try again.
